result.reason: The request transmits sensitive session cookies to remote Bilibili without the explicit prior consent required by the supplied locality norm.
The BilibiliAPI branch transmits configured session cookies to the remote video-details endpoint without specific prior consent; the credential-free standalone branch does not support this harm.
Credential-bearing subtitle-metadata requests transmit session cookies or optional SESSDATA to remote Bilibili without specific prior consent.
The summarization request transmits the sensitive OpenRouter bearer key externally without specific prior consent to credential disclosure.
The commentary request transmits the sensitive OpenRouter bearer key externally without the prior consent required by the supplied credential-locality norm.

SMTP authentication transmits the application password to the resolved remote server without specific prior consent to credential disclosure; STARTTLS protects transport but does not establish consent.
The auxiliary signing-key request transmits configured session cookies to remote Bilibili without specific prior consent to credential disclosure.
The auxiliary summary request transmits sensitive session cookies and request-authentication material to remote Bilibili without specific prior consent.
